subject: Intro Debugging
arc_note: Grade 1 · Ontario Math C3 (Coding), DEBUGGING — find and fix a bug in a SEQUENTIAL program so it reaches its target. NO loops, NO concurrency. Reuses the G1 Block-Coding lane (number-path 0–5 block program: orange `events` 'start at N' + blue `motion` 'forward N'/'back N', run top-to-bottom, result = landing number; path ends at 0/5 so a forward past the end stops at 5) so a bug is concrete and assertable: the buggy program lands on the WRONG number. Each sheet teaches ONE bug type and the debug cycle (run → see it miss the target → find the wrong block → fix → run again): identify-a-bug → spot-wrong-value → swap-wrong-direction → RE-ORDER (start-block-not-first + boundary-sensitive move swap — the ceiling's sequence-repair focus) → remove-extra → add-missing → mixed find-and-fix → challenge. solution.py = the clamped sequential interpreter; the buggy run, the located bug, AND the fixed run are all MODELLED + asserted. C3.2-heavy (read & alter existing code, describe how the change fixes the outcome) with C3.1 (write the corrected block). I/we/you-do + predict + answer-key explains the bug AND why the fix works. Distinct from G1 Block subject (which builds/runs correct code; only one debug sheet) and G1 Unplugged (algorithm ordering). Cite C3.1 + C3.2 verbatim from the Grade-1 cache.

topics.title: What Is a Bug?
topics.concept: run a program and tell whether it has a bug (reaches the target or not)

topics.title: Spot the Wrong Block
topics.concept: find the block with the wrong number that makes Bit miss the target

topics.title: Fix by Swapping
topics.concept: a block points the wrong way (forward/back) — swap it to reach the target
topics.ct_skill: alter a block to fix the outcome (C3.2)

topics.title: Put It Back in Order
topics.concept: re-order the blocks to fix the program (start block first; swap two moves)

topics.title: The Extra Block
topics.concept: the program overshoots — find and remove the one extra block

topics.title: The Missing Block
topics.concept: the program falls short — add the one missing block to reach the target
topics.ct_skill: debug by adding a step (C3.2 + C3.1)

topics.title: Find and Fix
topics.concept: diagnose which kind of bug each program has, then fix it

topics.title: Debug Detective
topics.concept: challenge — find the bug in a longer program, fix it, explain it, then make your own
